name: cable high pull with rope attachment
description: A rope pull toward the face from a high pulley. It builds the rear delts and upper back.
instructions: Attach a rope to a high pulley and grip an end in each hand.
Step back until the cable is taut, with a slight lean back.
Pull the rope toward your face, elbows flaring high.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the end.
Let the rope return slowly to the start.
